placement.note: Headline names 完凸フランシス (fully-awakened Francis) among the strongest; Francis is ★4, and the page criteria evaluate 4★ up to A6.
Page shows 'Review coming soon' and has no Tier Position section.

High and Max tiers carry the page's 'S' marker: the tier-list page legend defines S = Signature Weapon. High reads T2 with signature (Ophelia's signature, per the guide text), T3 without; Max reads T2 at A6 with signature.

source.criteria_caveat: Rates each character at Low, High and Max investment. Where a level has two tiers, we count the first one listed.

level_definitions.high: Assumes higher awakenings and stronger signature weapon investment.
level_definitions.low: Assumes accessible awakenings and limited signature weapon investment.
level_definitions.max: Assumes full ascension, at A6, on every character ranked.
